participation.context: Refused a third stop and kept the new comedy off the yard.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Asked for the old cues and left the seventeen days where they were.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Stayed civil and stayed out of a scene that was not this morning's.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Held the songs and sent Nick to eat.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Showed the two stops in the book and kept the plot to the old one.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Reported the breath, did not speak the speech, and went to eat.
participation.name: Nick Sorrell

story.body: You walked the old book for the Seven Deadly Sins, left Nick's speech unsaid, and did not open a tally.

title: Walked the old book for the Seven Deadly Sins

participation.context: Refused a new figure and kept the twopence personal.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Itemised the two unpaid sums and named no share.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Reported the Wednesday stair and brought no figure.
participation.name: Goodwife Margery Pell

participation.context: Kept the eight shillings visible and unpaid.
participation.name: Edith Kettlewood

participation.context: Named the fifty and said nothing was bought.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Kept his name off the page.
participation.name: Will Kemp

story.body: You sat the reckoning and came away with the gown unpaid, Edith unpaid, no share named, and your own twopence kept out of the company book.

title: Sat the reckoning and heard both debts still owed

story.body: You repeated the unpaid page to yourself and did not go out to make Sunday's work tonight.
